scripts.copy:client: npx rimraf src/assets/client/index.js src/assets/client/index.css && npx cpy client/dist/index.js client/dist/index.css src/assets/client/ --flat
scripts.copy:server: npx rimraf src/assets/server && npx mkdirp src/assets/server && npx cpy server/dist/server.js server/package.json server/package-lock.json src/assets/server/ --flat && cd src/assets/server && npm ci --omit=dev
scripts.build:electron: npm run build:client && npm run build:server && npm run copy:client && npm run copy:server
scripts.dist: npm run build:electron && cd src && npm run make
